subject: Northwind AI escalation: usage token counts don’t match expectation
thread_body:
From: Eli Turner <eli@northwind.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 4:08 PM
Subject: Usage dashboard doesn’t match our logs

Hi Vanessa,

We’re seeing a mismatch between our internal token estimates and what Redwood is showing in the usage dashboard + invoice preview. It looks like ~18–25% higher than expected for the same request volume.

We can share request IDs if helpful.

Thanks,
Eli


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eli Turner <eli@northwind.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 4:21 PM
Subject: Re: Usage dashboard doesn’t match our logs

Thanks Eli — looping in Priya (billing) and we’ll pull logs.

Could you send: (1) 10–20 representative request IDs, (2) whether you use streaming, and (3) any retry logic on non-200s?


From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Eli Turner <eli@northwind.ai>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 4:34 PM
Subject: Re: Usage dashboard doesn’t match our logs

Eli — we’ll investigate. One common source of confusion is how we count tokens on streamed responses vs client-side cancellation, and whether retries lead to multiple billable attempts.

If you have a sample where you cancelled a stream mid-way, call that out.


From: Eli Turner <eli@northwind.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, Feb 11, 2025 at 5:02 PM
Subject: Re: Usage dashboard doesn’t match our logs

Got it. We do streaming and we do client timeouts (15s) and retry once.

Here are request IDs (prod, us-east):
- req_7c2a…
- req_98ff…
- req_1b77…
- req_c3d1…
- req_3e0a…


From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 8:36 AM
Subject: Re: Northwind AI escalation: usage token counts don’t match expectation

I’m filing a support ticket and will coordinate with Eng Platform. Likely related to retries being counted as separate attempts and our usage UI not making that explicit.

Ticket: SUP-1842


From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Eli Turner <eli@northwind.ai>
Cc: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, Feb 12, 2025 at 9:14 AM
Subject: Re: Northwind AI escalation: usage token counts don’t match expectation

Thanks Eli — we’re digging in now. We’ll update you today with what we find + any short-term workaround.
